pools.name: NoSSD
pools.source: NoSSD runs its own protocol, not the official pool protocol: every block it wins pays both shares to one fixed address (pool_puzzle_hash equals farmer_puzzle_hash). NoSSD does not publish a pool_info endpoint. Cross-referenced via nossd.com/blocks: block 9305425 there (header_hash 0x1bde131ffbac39c4d17f7e0bc2d165faf6f2ece57d39136b3afed28c0301dcda) matches Coinset's get_block_record_by_height for that header_hash, whose pool_puzzle_hash is this entry (read 2026-09-17).

pools.name: Spacefarmers.io
pools.source: Claim target: https://xch.spacefarmers.io/pool_info (target_puzzle_hash, read 2026-09-17). The payout address is a separate fixed address Spacefarmers.io also operates for both shares (pool_puzzle_hash equals farmer_puzzle_hash on every sampled block), cross-referenced against xchmempool.com's pool table, which labels it "Spacefarmers.io both shares" (read 2026-09-17).

pools.name: H9.com
pools.source: Claim target: https://chiapp.hpool.com/pool_info and https://chiapp-asia.hpool.in/pool_info (name "The H9 chia protocol pool", target_puzzle_hash, read 2026-09-17). The payout address is H9's fixed both-shares address (pool_puzzle_hash equals farmer_puzzle_hash on every sampled block); H9's dashboard requires an account, so it is cross-referenced against xchmempool.com's pool table and miningpoolstats.stream/chia instead (read 2026-09-17).
